mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_mini_subscribe(user_id, template_key, accepted, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{templateKey}, #{accepted}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE accepted = VALUES(accepted), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, template_key AS templateKey, accepted, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_mini_subscribe WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY template_key
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, template_key AS templateKey, accepted, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_mini_subscribe WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND template_key = #{templateKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_notify_delivery_log(notification_id, recipient_user_id, channel, template_key, status, source_code, source_name, channel_name, recipient_name, title, content, max_retries, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{recipientUserId}, #{channel}, #{templateKey}, #{status}, #{sourceCode}, #{sourceName}, #{channelName}, #{recipientName}, #{title}, #{content}, #{maxRetries}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notify_delivery_log SET status = 'SUCCESS', provider_msg_id = #{providerMsgId}, error_code = NULL, error_msg = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE sys_notify_delivery_log SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notify_delivery_log WHERE channel = #{channel} AND status = 'FAILED' AND update_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notify_delivery_log SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

sql.if: AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR recipient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR source_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR source_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT id, notification_id, recipient_user_id, channel, template_key, status, source_code, source_name, channel_name, recipient_name, title, content, error_code, error_msg, retry_count, max_retries, create_time, update_time FROM sys_notify_delivery_log WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sent24h, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success24h, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed24h, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SKIPPED_QUIET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skippedQuiet24h, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SKIPPED_RATE_LIMIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skippedRate24h FROM sys_notify_delivery_log WHERE create_time >= #{startTime}

SELECT id, notification_id, recipient_user_id, channel, template_key, status, source_code, source_name, channel_name, recipient_name, title, content, error_code, error_msg, provider_msg_id, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time FROM sys_notify_delivery_log WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM sys_notify_delivery_log WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) GROUP BY channel
